The '''''Buirk'alor''-class airspeeder''' was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] designed and constructed by [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] company headquartered on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Measuring just over ten [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length and possessing powerful [[Engine/Legends|engines]], the ''Buirk'alor''-class [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] was favored by [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] units of the [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian]], who utilized the unarmed vessel to patrol the New Mandalorians' [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]. The New Mandalorians' [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and her [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] guest, [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], also made use of a ''Buirk'alor''-class speeder for [[Transport/Legends|transport]] during [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], while investigating the [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] of several New Mandalorian [[Youngling/Legends|children]].

==Characteristics==
Measuring 10.19 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, the ''Buirk'alor''-class [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] was equipped with a set of powerful [[Engine/Legends|engines]] that it relied upon for propulsion. Manufactured by the [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] company, the unarmed ''Buirk'alor'' [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] was constructed primarily as a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] craft, and police models featured the flashing lights common to law-enforcement vessels mounted on its roof.<ref name="TCWIV" /> Additionally, the word "police" was prominently displayed on the frame of the airspeeder's nose<ref name="Corruption" /> in the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']].<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref> The ''Buirk'alor''-class airspeeder's small [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] provided seating for up to four individuals, including the vehicle's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="Corruption" />

==Role==
A swift airspeeder design, the ''Buirk'alor''-class model was used primarily by [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] members of the [[Mandalorian Guard/Legends|Mandalorian Guard]]. These [[Officer/Legends|officers]] patrolled the [[Skylane/Legends|skylanes]] of the New Mandalorians' [[Domed city/Legends|domed]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]],<ref name="TCWIV" /> [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]].<ref name="Corruption" /> They relied on the airspeeder's powerful engines to allow them to respond rapidly to emergency situations, and speedily carry them to the scene of a crime.<ref name="TCWIV" />

==History==
Designed and constructed by MandalMotors,<ref name="TCWIV" /> a prominent Mandalorian [[Starship/Legends|starship]] company headquartered in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the ''Buirk'alor''-class airspeeder was produced at some point in [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="Corruption Date">{{FactFile2014|48|21 BBY 13-14|Corruption on Mandalore}}</ref> for use by the New Mandalorian police. The [[Police officer/Legends|officers]] of the Mandalorian Guard force took to using the ''Buirk'alor'' for patrolling the skylanes of the New Mandalorians' cities.<ref name="TCWIV" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a number of ''Buirk'alor''-class airspeeders were mobilized during the course of an [[Mandalorian black market conspiracy/Legends|investigation]] into the sudden [[Poison/Legends|illness]] that had stricken and [[Sundari Mandalorian hospital/Legends|hospitalized]] several New Mandalorian [[Youngling/Legends|children]] within Sundari. One even provided [[Transport/Legends|transport]] for New Mandalorian [[Anti-Mandalore|leader]] [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and her [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] guest, [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], as they moved about the city in search of the source of the children's illness.<ref name="Corruption" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Buirk'alor''-class airspeeder made its first unnamed appearance in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] episode, ''[[Corruption (episode)|Corruption]]'', originally aired on [[October 8]], [[2010]].<ref name="Corruption" /> The name of the Mandalorian police vehicle was only revealed with the publication of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' guide book.<ref name="TCWIV" />

The name ''Buirk'alor'' appears to come from the Mandalorian language developed by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]], specifically the ''Mando'a'' words ''buirkan'', meaning "responsibility", and ''alor'', meaning "leader".<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>
